beats.say: Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on 19 November for PlayStation 5.
Rockstar Games confirmed development in February 2022 after principal production began in 2020.
The story moves to the fictional state of Leonida, based on Florida.
You play as the duo Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in an open world.
The game brings back the Snapmatic app from GTA 5, but what happens next is in Part 2.
Gaming Shorts land every day, so subscribe to catch every update.
This massive gaming event begins because...

facts: Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to be released on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
Rockstar confirmed in February 2022 that the game was in development.
Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
Grand Theft Auto VI will feature a fully integrated social media app called Snapmatic, returning from Grand Theft Auto V.
